lore.twin_gate: Two openings ask a question that no single path can answer.
lore.clicking_ear: It hears arrivals, never amounts; if a thing comes in pieces, this is what finds out.
lore.path_brand: It blocks nothing and only records which way you went, and that alone is enough to erase the pattern.
lore.threshold_plate: Dim blue light frees electrons that the fiercest red never will, which is how colour turned out to be counted rather than measured.
lore.severed_twin: Ask both halves the same question far apart, and the answers agree more often than any arrangement made in advance could manage.
lore.photon: It arrives all at once or not at all, yet it reaches the screen by every route it could have taken.
lore.electron: Send them one at a time with hours between, and the fringes still assemble themselves out of single arrivals.
lore.buckyball: Sixty carbon atoms are heavy enough to picture and still light enough to go through both slits, so the line you were looking for is not there.
lore.water_wave: It interferes beautifully and proves nothing quantum, because interference is what waves do, not what quantum things do.
lore.marble: Its wavelength is real and smaller than a proton by a factor with twenty zeroes, which is the honest reason you never see it spread.
lore.entangled_pair: Neither twin carries a fringe of its own, because each one's path is already written on the other.
lore.decohered_beam: Still photons, still counted one by one, but the room has read their paths already and the fringes left with the secret.
lore.unasked_question: Wave or particle was never a property of the thing; it was a property of the question, and the question can be withdrawn after the answer arrives.
